en.topic_title: Dozens of Hong Kong Christian groups petition against tourism body’s ‘Halloween Month’ campaign
en.topic_summary:
Dozens of Christian groups in Hong Kong have signed a petition against a “Halloween Month” campaign launched by the city’s tourism body on the grounds that celebrating the western ghost festival could harm the wellbeing of the next generation.



Halloween revellers in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
